target.definition: Number of foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in September 2026, as first reported in JNTO's monthly estimate.

inputs.name: annual_visitors_2025
inputs.description: Total foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in calendar year 2025.

provenance.rationale: Extrapolates recent strong growth from 2024 levels (~36.9M) and recovery trends.

inputs.name: annual_growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for foreign visitor arrivals from 2025 to 2026.

provenance.rationale: Assumes continued but moderating growth, with uncertainty due to economic and geopolitical factors.

inputs.name: september_share_of_annual
inputs.description: Fraction of annual foreign visitor arrivals that occur in September.

provenance.rationale: September is a shoulder month; historical monthly shares typically range 7-9%.

inputs.name: september_2025_visitors
inputs.description: Foreign visitor arrivals to Japan in September 2025.

provenance.rationale: Based on recent monthly levels around 3-3.5 million in 2025.

inputs.name: september_yoy_growth_factor
inputs.description: Year-over-year growth factor for September foreign visitor arrivals from 2025 to 2026.

provenance.rationale: Similar to annual growth, but with slightly higher uncertainty for a single month.

inputs.name: daily_arrivals_peak
inputs.description: Average daily foreign visitor arrivals during peak season (e.g., summer).

provenance.rationale: Peak daily arrivals in 2025 estimated from monthly totals and seasonal patterns.

inputs.name: september_seasonality_factor
inputs.description: Ratio of September daily arrivals to peak-season daily arrivals.

provenance.rationale: September is less busy than peak summer; factor reflects typical seasonal dip.

inputs.name: japan_outbound_2025
inputs.description: Number of Japanese outbound travelers in 2025.

provenance.rationale: Japanese outbound travel has been recovering; 2025 estimate based on trends.

inputs.name: inbound_outbound_ratio
inputs.description: Ratio of foreign visitor arrivals to Japanese outbound travelers.

provenance.rationale: In recent years, inbound has significantly exceeded outbound; ratio around 2.5-3.

inputs.name: september_share_of_outbound
inputs.description: Fraction of annual Japanese outbound travelers that occur in September.

provenance.rationale: Similar seasonality to inbound, with September being a shoulder month.

paths.description: Estimate annual 2026 visitors from 2025 total and growth, then allocate to September using seasonal share.
Start from September 2025 actuals and apply year-over-year growth factor.
Use peak daily arrivals scaled by September seasonality factor and days in month.
